key_findings: TMEM233 is required for ExTxA-induced inhibition of Nav1.7 inactivation and for toxin-evoked pain behaviors in mice.
TMEM233 is a previously unknown Nav1.7-interacting protein that modestly alters Nav1.7 inactivation.
